verdict.rationale: AMD's product page confirms FSR 'Redstone' support (docs-15), establishing that this GPU supports FSR-based upscaling/frame generation, but there is no documented game support list, no mention of specific FSR version features (e.g. frame generation details), and no independent hands-on corroboration of broad game compatibility. missing for 10: documented list of supported FSR generation features (upscaling vs frame-gen), specific supported game count/list, independent/hands-on verification of broad game support.
